findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "eu_trade_quotas" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: cn, country, order_number, celex, history, cursor, limit

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_watched_tenders, sanctions_list_changes · Private data: get_tender_deadline_changes, eu_contract_awards, get_eu_contract_award, sanctions_list_changes, eu_funding_changes, sanctions_search, sanctions_entry · Public sink: list_watched_tenders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_watched_tenders, sanctions_list_changes · Private data: get_tender_deadline_changes, eu_contract_awards, get_eu_contract_award, sanctions_list_changes, eu_funding_changes, sanctions_search, sanctions_entry · Public sink: list_watched_tenders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
